data.name: Nahyan
data.gender_notes: Nahyan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahyan is an Arabic name that signifies a high status or rank. It is derived from the Arabic word 'naha', meaning 'to elevate' or 'to exalt'. The name Nahyan carries the meaning “Elevated, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nahyan usually hope their child will grow to embody elevated, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nahyan is considered a name that reflects the qualities of Allah, who is the Exalted and Elevated One.
data.etymology: Nahyan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elevated, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahyan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: نہیَان
in_urdu.meaning: نہیَان نام وہ ہے جو عدل اور سچائی کا نام ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Nahyan holds a special place in Islamic history as it was the name of the legendary caliph, Caliph Al-Nahyan bin Mubarak Al-Mansur (711-744 AD), the Founder of Al-Mansour City in Al-Fustat, which is the ancient name of Cairo, Egypt. Al-Nahyan was known for his wisdom, piety, and military skills. His reign was marked by peace, prosperity, and a flourishing of Islamic culture in Egypt.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Nahyan holds a symbolic meaning as it reminds us of the elevated status that we can attain through righteous deeds and piety. It encourages us to strive for excellence, both in this world and in the hereafter. The name is a reminder that our purpose in life is to seek closeness to Allah (God), and that through humility, perseverance, and submission, we can elevate our spiritual selves and attain a higher rank in Allah's sight.
